Goal + constraints" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#eaf2ff;strokeColor=#6b96cf;fontColor=#20334b;strokeWidth=2;fontSize=28;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry x="20" y="70" width="370" height="96" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="startup" value="Task + host context

svg.title: Separate worker context with a bounded result
svg.desc: A main thread delegates a bounded brief. The worker receives the task plus host-provided startup context and keeps its own intermediate reads and tool trace. A requested concise result and evidence return to the parent. Host metadata also contributes context; forks and resumed workers can inherit history.
